if not last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
    # Find character
    char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
    char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char['boundary']) // len(char['boundary'])
    print(f"Character at col ~{char_c}")
    
    # Move to passage position (cols 38-42)

    for i in range(10):
        result = action(['LEFT'])
        seg = current_frame.segmentation
        char = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] <= 10][0]
        char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char['boundary']) // len(char['boundary'])
        print(f"After LEFT #{i+1}: char at col ~{char_c}")
        if char_c <= 40:
            break
    
    # Try ACTION7

    char_c = sum(p[1] for p in char_pos) // len(char_pos)
    print(f"After ACTION7: char at ({char_r}, {char_c})")
    print(f"Done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    # Check blue regions

    print(f"Blue regions: {len(blue_nodes)}")
    for bn in blue_nodes:
